subject: Exclusive Spring Sale - Limited Time Only!
body: Dear valued customer, We are excited to announce our Exclusive Spring Sale with up to 50% off on selected items! Don't miss this opportunity to refresh your wardrobe with the latest trends at unbeatable prices. From stylish dresses to comfortable activewear, we have something for everyone. Hurry, as stocks are limited! Visit our store or shop online today to enjoy these amazing discounts. Happy shopping! Best regards, The Fashion Store Team
